setup.correct_reduction: sum(per-token losses) / sum(n_valid) over the step
setup.broken_reduction: mean_i(mean of per-token losses in micro-batch i)
setup.eval_metric: token-weighted held-out loss on a fixed batch set

headline.sweep_note: the error is monotone in the realised imbalance (coefficient of variation of valid tokens), not in sigma: past sigma~1.2 the lognormal tail is clipped at T so the realised imbalance stops growing
